context: Two news editors plan an evening political debate segment
purpose: Teach: 在日/論争/分科/融合/肯定/決定的/奪わ/有限

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 今夜の討論、テーマは在日コミュニティの権利問題でいきたいんですが。
lines.en: For tonight's debate, I'd like the theme to be the rights of resident foreigners.
lines.style: Measured, professional, pitching the segment direction clearly.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 面白いけど、また激しい論争になるよ。前回の放送、苦情の電話すごかったでしょ。
lines.en: Interesting, but it'll spark heated debate again. Remember the flood of complaints last time.
lines.style: Cautious office veteran, gently pushing back from experience.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: だからこそ価値があると思うんです。各党の分科会の議事録、もう全部読み込みました。
lines.en: That's exactly why it's worth doing. I've already read every party subcommittee's minutes.
lines.style: Earnest, slightly defensive, leaning forward with conviction.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 熱意は買うけどね。保守と革新の意見の融合を狙うなら、司会者の選定が決定的だよ。
lines.en: I appreciate the passion. If you're aiming to blend conservative and progressive views, the moderator choice is decisive.
lines.style: Pragmatic mentor tone, acknowledging then redirecting toward execution.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 森田先生にお願いしたいです。あの方なら頭から否定せず、肯定的な部分も拾ってくれる。
lines.en: I want to ask Professor Morita. She won't dismiss views outright; she'll surface the affirmative side too.
lines.style: Hopeful and respectful, naming a trusted figure.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: なるほどね。ただ尺は有限だから、二時間で詰め込みすぎると、結局視聴者から思考の時間を奪われた感じになるよ。
lines.en: I see. But airtime is finite, so cramming two hours risks leaving viewers feeling robbed of time to think.
lines.style: Calm editorial wisdom, mindful of the audience experience.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: じゃあ前半は当事者インタビュー、後半を討論にして、CMは最小限に絞ります。
lines.en: Then I'll do interviews with those affected first half, debate second half, and trim ads to a minimum.
lines.style: Quick to adapt, restructuring the rundown on the fly.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: うん、それなら通せそう。台本の初稿、今夜九時までに私の机に置いといて。
lines.en: Okay, that I can sign off on. Drop the first script draft on my desk by nine tonight.
lines.style: Decisive close, granting approval with a firm deadline.
